records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?

*flips back through a few pages*

This is genuinely impressive, by the way. Like, I find this kind of thing a bit uncomfortable to be on the receiving end of, but as a document of what actually happened? It's remarkable. Right, so. If I had to do it over… I don't know. I mean, I think we handled the immediate stuff well enough. But… I guess I'd try to keep things a bit more open. And I'd make sure everyone knew they could speak up about stuff. Like, Donatello with the crackers, Mikey with the swimming idea. If we'd had that conversation sooner, maybe things would have been a bit different.

But other than that? I don't think I'd change much. We were all just trying to stay alive, you know?

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.

records.response_pred: Alright, alright. So you'll have a nice, tidy summary for when we get out of this. That's good, Mikey, just... don't go overboard, yeah? We can all look at it when we're back to normal, but for now, let's keep things simple.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?

The whole time we've been here it's been tasks and rationing and protocols, and that was necessary, you were right about all of that — but the flowers were the bit that said we weren't just surviving, we were still ourselves.

I don't know. Maybe that's what gets you through it in the end. Not just the plans. The flowers too.
records.response_pred: The flowers? Nah, I reckon it was more about making a statement, ya know? Got to stand out, right? Rescue might not be looking for flowers, but if it means we get seen, it's worth a shot. Plus, it's something to do, keeps the mind off other stuff.

Yeah, I'm alright. Just... give me a second.

*exhales slowly*

I'm fine. I'm really fine. Come here.
